thread:
lina: Heads-up: CI is failing for the NebulaX model examples — looks like a naming mismatch between the model card and SDK samples. noticed in failing CI: https://ci.redwood/builds/12901 :frowning:

eric: thanks. which files? I can grep for variants.

lina: two quick hits: docs/models/NebulaX-4B.md (Title case, dash) and examples/generate/nebulax/sample.md where the snippet uses `client.generate(\"NebulaX-4B\", ...)`. SDK expects `nebulax-4b` per manifest.

eric: ok that explains test harness failures. plan: normalize canonical name to `nebulax-4b` across model_index.yml, support_matrix.yaml, and examples. add an alias field to the model card so older references still resolve. branch: docs/fix/nebulax-naming.

tom: small caveat on embeddings: bench show embed accuracy varies with quant profile. recommend adding `embed-quant-profile: medium` to the examples and a short note on the model card. bench link: https://benchmarks.redwood/nebula/2026-03-20 .

lina: here's the failing snippet from examples/generate/nebulax/sample.md:

```
# example
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(\"NebulaX-4B\", prompt=\"Summarize this...\", max_tokens=128)
print(resp.text)
```

eric: I'll update snippets to `nebulax-4b` and add a one-line migration note: \"If you previously used `NebulaX-4B`, update to `nebulax-4b` or set `model_alias: NebulaX-4B` in your manifest.\" Also will patch support_matrix.yaml row.

dev-bot: CI | docs-integration 5 mins ago  failed (examples tests) logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/12901

eric: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwoodinference/docs/pull/861 . Changes: model card alias, normalized examples, support_matrix entry, short embed quality note + link to tom's bench. requesting review from @lina @tom.

tom: quick review done  nit: prefer `model_aliases: [\"NebulaX-4B\"]` over `model_alias` (plural) to allow future entries. also add `tested_on: p4d` in notes.

eric: updated. also added a tiny SDK snippet in examples/embeddings showing `client.embed("nebulax-4b", ...)` and a comment about `embed-quant-profile`.

dev-bot: CI | docs-integration 5 mins ago  success.

lina: verified locally — examples pass and the docs search resolves older links to the new card. thanks all :thumbsup:

eric: merging and adding release note: docs: normalize NebulaX naming, add alias + embed note. closing ticket.
